column1: # This registry is only for source-built providers that have been verified
# absent from the matching K230 target runtime.  It is merged into a copied
# candidate-private owner map after the target-runtime cache is restored, so a
# future provider does not regenerate target-derived IPKs or recompile older
# source closures.  A SONAME found in the target belongs instead in the
# target-runtime catalogue / attestation path and must not be listed here.
